changelog.summary: Carry an accepted priced SaaS offer through positioning into a reviewed launch plan with current claims, owners and channels.

title: Accepted Offer to Launch Readiness
description: Carry an accepted priced SaaS offer through positioning into a reviewed launch plan with current claims, owners and channels.
setup_prompt: Use Accepted Offer to Launch Readiness as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing Crews, source permissions, exact subject, owner and action policy. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, typed handoffs, a real manual first case and separate approval for consequential actions. Show the plan before Builder applies it. Selection enables no write or recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: One offer, plan, price revision, buyer segment, intended launch window and accountable pricing and GTM owners.
Read current billing price, entitlement and contract exceptions, approved claims, buyer evidence, channel policy and asset revisions.
The exact offer must be accepted before positioning; every launch claim must cite an approved current source; assets remain unlaunched until separate review.
Accountable source, decision and action owners
Authorized connections or equivalent current exports
Manual-only or reviewed event and schedule policy
